description: Event catalogue for the Customer Complaint Handling journey. Introduces 4 new events: EVT-138 through EVT-141. All events are published by SVC-001 (Retail Banking Core) and consumed by SVC-015 (Compliance Core), SVC-053 (Notifications), and SVC-103 (Audit & Logging). Events are routed via SVC-102 (Event Bus).

events.name: ComplaintReceived
events.trigger: Customer submits a complaint via any channel. SVC-001 creates ComplaintCase with status = received.

payload_schema.affected_product_type: string enum (current_account | savings | mortgage | personal_loan | credit_card | payment | insurance | other)
payload_schema.complaint_type: string enum (conduct | service | product | fraud | pricing | other)
payload_schema.channel_received: string enum (web | mobile | branch | phone | post | email)

consumers.action: Increment DISP complaint counter for product category. Initialise DisCaseSummary tracking.
Dispatch acknowledgement notification to customer: complaint reference, regulatory timeline, FOS information.
Write immutable audit record of complaint receipt. DISP 1.9.1R 3-year retention.

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-customer ordering via customer_id partition key on topic retail.complaints.
events.worm_rationale: Contains customer_id (PII) and complaint reference. Required for DISP 1.9.1R 3-year audit trail.

events.name: ComplaintTriaged
events.trigger: PER-062 completes triage — assigns category, severity, owner, and target resolution date.

derived_from.severity: ComplaintCase.severity — set by PER-062 at triage

consumers.action: If regulated_flag = true: apply enhanced monitoring flag. Alert PER-052 (Compliance Officer).

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-customer ordering via customer_id partition key.

events.name: ComplaintResolved
events.trigger: PER-062 determines complaint outcome and records resolution decision.

payload_schema.redress_amount: string (decimal as string, e.g. '50.00') — GBP — null if no financial redress
payload_schema.redress_payment_id: string (UUID v4) — null if no redress
payload_schema.elapsed_business_days: integer — business days from received_at to resolved_at

consumers.action: Update DisCaseSummary: increment complaints_upheld or complaints_rejected. Record redress_amount.

events.worm_rationale: Outcome and redress amount legally significant. DISP 1.9.1R audit trail.

events.name: ComplaintClosed
events.trigger: Resolution communication dispatched to customer and ComplaintCase status updated to closed.

derived_from.response_type: ComplaintCase.response_type — computed: if elapsed <= 3 business days then summary_resolution_communication else final_response_letter

consumers.action: Update DisCaseSummary: increment complaints_closed, update median_resolution_days, check SLA breaches.
Dispatch resolution communication to customer — template selected based on response_type.
Write immutable closure audit record with full complaint lifecycle summary.

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-customer ordering. ComplaintClosed must follow ComplaintResolved for the same complaint_id.
events.worm_rationale: Full complaint lifecycle closure. DISP 1.9.1R 3-year retention.
events.retention: 3 years minimum (DISP 1.9.1R), extended for FOS-referred complaints
